flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/lta/download/helpers/{LtaBatchCode0Processor,LtaSnowflakeProcessor,LtaIdTypeUtil}, framework/services/datahive/contact/DataHiveContactServiceImpl, framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findAdvisoryNoticeLetters), cron-schedules-prod.properties. A generic mechanism (same for NOPO) with the AN_SMS/AN_EMAIL templates. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code for this story
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. After the LTA owner data arrives, LTA Download maps the ID type, skips the contact lookup for passports, calls DataHive for NRIC/FIN/UEN, writes the mobile number and email to ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver, then routes the notice to ENA (contact found) or RD1 (no contact). An AN notice at stage ENA with an_flag Y is picked up by the eNotification job, which uses the AN_SMS/AN_EMAIL templates and then applies PS-ANS after sending. Main gap: the eNotification scheduler is switched off in the PROD properties (cron.notification.enabled=false, comment 'Disabled in PROD to prevent sending SMS/Email notifications'), so the electronic AN notification does not run automatically in PROD. The detailed Epic OCMS9 rules are not traced in this chunk; the DataHive contact data, the SMS/email gateway, and any per-environment override cannot verify from repo. The demo remark (Vault) cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket used. The stale cronservice/ folder is not used.
recommendation: Claim with a caveat. ID type identification, the contact lookup, the mobile/email update and the ENA/RD1 routing exist. The electronic AN notification is off in the PROD properties and the Epic OCMS9 rules are not verified.

steps.step: OCMS identifies the vehicle owner's ID type from the LTA data
steps.detail: Same as OCMS10.4: LtaIdTypeUtil.mapLtaOwnerIdTypeToOcms maps the LTA code to N, F, P or B (LtaIdTypeUtil.java:42-57) and the result is saved as the owner id_type (LtaBatchCode0Processor.java:456-458; an unknown code becomes '-' at 1449-1465). The classification is used again by the contact lookup (ContactIdTypeClassifier) and by the notification channel choice (UEN to email, others to SMS). The actual LTA codes cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS checks the owner's mobile number and email through DataHive (passports are skipped)
steps.detail: For a passport owner the lookup is skipped and the notice goes to RD1 (LtaBatchCode0Processor.java:693-698). For other types dataHiveContactService.lookupContact is called (706-709): input validation, ID type classification (NRIC/FIN via Singpass, UEN via Corppass), query build, execution with retry, result parsing (DataHiveContactServiceImpl.java:59-100). A preparation error is logged and the notice stops; a query error is logged (TS-SYS is commented out, not applied). The DataHive data and the connection access cannot verify from repo; the Epic OCMS9 rules are not traced here.

steps.step: OCMS updates the owner's mobile number and email on the notice data
steps.detail: When the lookup finds a mobile or email, planContactUpdate strips the number to digits, writes offenderTelNo with the Singapore country code, and emailAddr to ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver (LtaBatchCode0Processor.java:755-759, 772-798); when both are empty there is no update. The older path LtaSnowflakeProcessor.updateContactInfoFromResult (160-178) is the same; the 'only for Singpass' comment there is not enforced by the if condition. No format validation of the number/email beyond the digit cleanup was found.

steps.step: The notice is routed to the electronic notification path when a contact exists, or to the letter path when none exists
steps.detail: When the lookup result has a contact, the stage is changed to ENA (planStageToENA, LtaBatchCode0Processor.java:760); otherwise to RD1 (762). An AN notice with an_flag Y and next stage RD1 is then picked by findAdvisoryNoticeLetters for the AN letter (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:690-707), while one at ENA enters the eNotification query (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1000-1030). This branching is generic, with no AN-specific distinction in LTA.

steps.step: The electronic AN notification (SMS or email) can be sent to the owner
steps.detail: The eNotification job selects notices at stage ENA (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1000-1030), uses the AN_SMS (individual) or AN_EMAIL (company) template when an_flag is Y (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:277-282, 352-380), and applies PS-ANS after sending (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:398-407). But cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 has cron.notification.enabled=false with the comment 'Disabled in PROD to prevent sending SMS/Email notifications' (231-235), so the automatic sending does not run in PROD. The sending itself (stories OCMS10.6 and OCMS10.7) and the SMS/email gateway cannot verify from repo.
